**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/26 (Fri) 03:17
- [FACT] User has a peace lily that has been looking droopy lately.
- [FACT] User has a fiddle leaf fig named Felix, which they water on Wednesdays.
- [PREFERENCE] User has been using a balanced, water-soluble fertilizer on their African violets, which seem to be doing well.
- [CHANGE] User is considering switching to a fertilizer that is more suitable for their peace lily.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Over-fertilization can cause droopy leaves; user should stop fertilizing for now to allow the peace lily to recover.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should check the soil moisture by sticking their finger into the soil and water only if it feels dry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should flush the soil by watering the peace lily thoroughly to leach out excess fertilizer salts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should provide good air circulation for the peace lily and prune any damaged leaves.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should monitor temperature and humidity, keeping the peace lily in temperatures between 65°F to 80°F (18°C to 27°C).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User may consider repotting the peace lily in fresh, well-draining potting soil if the soil is heavily contaminated with fertilizer salts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended fertilizers for peace lilies include Miracle-Gro Indoor Plant Food (24-8-16), Schultz All Purpose Plant Food (20-20-20), Espoma Organic Indoor Plant Fertilizer (2-2-2), and E.B. Stone Organics Bloom! (5-3-4).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should follow the instructions on the fertilizer packaging and start with a diluted solution to avoid burning the peace lily's roots.
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering getting a humidity tray for their peace lily to help with dry air.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A humidity tray is a good idea for peace lilies, as they thrive in humid environments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should use a shallow tray filled with pebbles to create a humid microclimate around the peace lily.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should monitor and refill the water level in the humidity tray regularly.
- [FACT] User has had good luck with their succulent arrangement on their desk and loves how easy they are to care for.
- [PREFERENCE] User is thinking of getting low-maintenance plants like succulents or air plants to add to their collection.
